title: Indian Quinoa Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious Indian-inspired quinoa pilaf, perfect for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.
instructions: Heat the velvety in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the cumin, coriander, and garam masala. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the pilaf and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the quinoa and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the soft and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the quinoa is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the quinoa pilaf with a fork and season with salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
